title: Official persist of manual clip gain Effects and volume keyframes
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of path-sorted sha256sum output in "digest  path\n" form (sort by path)
bounds: Manual clip gain persists as official type=gain Effects on audio clips only, via SetClipGain, SetGainKeyframe, and RemoveGainKeyframe. Keyframe times are quantized to the 48 kHz sample grid (KEYFRAME_NOT_ON_SAMPLE). Default 0 dB is a no-op; animated curves refuse SetClipGain (ANIMATED_GAIN_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_KEYFRAME_EDIT). Keys are absolute dB (static gainDb is not also multiplied). Admission allows at most one gain Effect per audio clip; limiter and pan Effect types stay UNSUPPORTED_EDIT_TECHNIQUE. Video clips refuse gain writes.

compileOfficialMixInputs reads the persisted gain Effect and feeds PcmInput.gainDb or a clip-local GainEnvelope so mix48k applies clip gain, then the existing default pan (0), then the track/master bus. Disabled gain is unity (0 dB). AUTO ducking is never written into the manual Effect.

applyOfficialClipAnalysis plans ducking as the already-admitted AUTO layer against the persisted manual Effect and does not rewrite Effect JSON (mutations=0). A locked audio track refuses TRACK_LOCKED; lockedFields of effects, effectIds, gain, or effects.* / effectIds.* refuse MANUAL_LOCKED. User edits on a locked track or those locked fields refuse FIELD_LOCKED. Whole-group refusal leaves the document unchanged.

Split, trim, and overwrite crop gain keyframes with param gainDb and rebind owners; slip leaves clip-local keys unchanged. This slice does not start I-060/V-024 limiter, open I-007 PCM remapping or nest, invent new tracks, change Pulse/clock/queue, claim I-023 complete, or add invert-matrix rows. Independent audio import is skipped because it would invent missing I-004 surfaces (AssetRepository / RelinkProposal / FileToken) or a new official audio track. Video and caption mute/solo stay FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState; syncLock is not toggled. Increment 1.17/1.18 stay open. Store tests are not used as evidence.
